description: This bar chart illustrates the count of different types across two models, with the x-axis labeled "Model" showing two categories: "Type1" and "Mistral 7B". The y-axis is labeled "Count" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The legend indicates four types: Type1 (teal), Type2 (orange), Type3 (blue), RR (pink), and WW (green). For the "Type1" model, the counts are approximately 15 for Type1, 25 for Type2, and 5 for Type3, with RR and WW bars not visible. For the "Mistral 7B" model, the counts are approximately 30 for Type1, 25 for Type2, and 120 for RR, with WW at approximately 30. The RR bar is the only one that reaches above 100, and it is consistently the tallest bar in each model category.
